Who We Are

At Eddie Pearson Roofing, we believe that regular roof inspections are one of the smartest investments a property owner can make. Whether you’re a homeowner wanting peace of mind or a business owner looking to prevent costly repairs, our detailed roof inspections help identify issues early—before they turn into major problems. Our trained professionals carefully examine every component of your roofing system, from shingles and flashing to underlayment and ventilation, ensuring nothing is overlooked.

We use industry-proven techniques, up-to-date safety standards, and years of hands-on experience to provide clear, accurate evaluations. Whether you’ve noticed signs of damage or simply want a routine checkup, we offer thorough inspection services that include documentation, photos, and honest recommendations. As a GAF Master Elite certified contractor, we bring a higher level of accountability and knowledge to every inspection, so you can make informed decisions about your roof with complete confidence.

Why Choose Us

Routine roof inspections can extend the life of your roof, catch minor issues before they escalate, and help you avoid expensive repairs or replacements down the road. With Eddie Pearson Roofing, you get trusted insight, professional evaluations, and peace of mind.

Our Roof Inspection Services Include:

  • Full Residential & Commercial Roof Assessments – Detailed inspections tailored to your home or business

  • Storm Damage Evaluations – Inspection following hail, wind, or heavy rain events

  • Pre-Sale Real Estate Roof Reports – Inspections for homeowners preparing to sell or buyers needing documentation

  • Insurance Claim Support – Inspection reports and photos to support your claim process

  • Leak Detection – Identify hidden leaks or weak spots before they cause water damage
